scope: Planning recommendations inferred from the quoted works and linked research; no site inspection, approval, order or budget replacement.

policy.owner_managed: Owner buys and organises a suitable supplier or finish trade; this does not mean untrained DIY for services, heavy glass, overhead supports or building alterations.
policy.professional: Owner may still buy or hire directly, but the named specialist must execute and any specified engineering/design review must happen first. A general contractor is one coordination option, not an automatic requirement for every row.
policy.approvals: The quote specifies approved designs and Site Engineer instructions for many works. Direct procurement and substitutions require agreement with the appointed consultant and any landlord requirements.
policy.holds: Six existing held works remain on hold. Classification does not release any of them.
policy.quantity: Display quoted SI scope quantities only. Retail panels, rugs, cabinets and packs require a separate confirmed take-off. New options and unsplit allowances have unknown purchase quantities.
policy.market: Retail/category listings are leads, not verified design equivalents or accepted quotes. Confirm stock, package contents, VAT, delivery, returns and installation before payment.
policy.rates: Original rates, amounts, currency qualifications and accepted component splits are unchanged. Product examples are separate catalogue observations, not replacements for v4/v7 prices or the original quote.

sources.title: NBC 207:2003 · Electrical design for public buildings
sources.supports: Electrical contractor competence, engineering advice at planning, earthing, inspection and testing. Project and current local requirements still need the appointed engineer.

sources.title: NBC 105:2025 · Seismic design
sources.locator: Official building-code listing and indexed PDF
sources.supports: Current Nepal seismic-design reference for the engineer. Full PDF retrieval failed during this review; no new numerical anchorage design is claimed.

sources.title: NBC 208:2003 · Sanitary and plumbing design
sources.supports: Identifies the sanitary/plumbing design reference. Full code text was not retrieved; plumber and engineering review recommendations below are scope-based planning judgments.

sources.title: Partitions and ceiling systems manual
sources.locator: Ceiling suspension, loading and luminaire supports
sources.supports: Suspension spacing depends on loading and fixtures can require additional support. Use the selected system manufacturer’s current details; this is technical guidance, not Nepal approval.

sources.title: Kathmandu flooring, curtains, furniture and panels
sources.supports: The supplier advertises curtains, carpet tiles, flooring, sofas, ceilings and wall panels, with a Kathmandu showroom. Obtain a measured supply/install quote; exact project matches were not verified.

sources.title: Sheer curtain · 4 × 7 ft · one panel
sources.supports: Demonstrates direct purchase by panel. The retrieved page contains stale delivery information; the price is catalogue evidence, not a current delivered quote.

sources.title: Hand-knotted wool carpet runner · 0.62 × 2 m
sources.supports: A loose runner is sold as a finished product, distinct from fitted carpet or laminate flooring. Confirm suitability, backing and delivery.

sources.title: Wooden shoe-rack category
sources.supports: Ready-made racks are listed in Nepal. Size, capacity and construction vary; this does not establish equivalence with the quoted fitted rack.

sources.title: Shoe racks and furniture catalogue
sources.supports: Direct furniture purchase is an available route. The detailed page timed out; dimensions, stock, delivery and any installation remain quote-required.

sources.title: Interior paint system and painting-service enquiry
sources.supports: The manufacturer describes putty/primer/topcoat preparation and offers direct painting-service enquiries in Nepal. Product choice must match the substrate; no quantity or coverage is inferred here.

sources.title: Bathluxe BV-888T wall-hung vanity
sources.supports: A vanity can be purchased separately. This example is wall-hung, with a basin and mirror cabinet; it requires a suitable support and coordinated plumbing.

example.stock: not independently confirmed; confirm package inclusions

sources.title: Bathroom hardware supply
sources.supports: Bathroom fittings are sold directly for Kathmandu delivery. Exact sink/vanity compatibility, valve/trap inclusions and current stock need confirmation.

sources.title: Find a dealer for sales, installation and service
sources.supports: The manufacturer provides a direct dealer route covering sales, installation and service. Confirm the selected brand’s installation package and warranty rather than assuming product price includes all works.

sources.title: Returns policy by product category
sources.supports: The home/living category policy excludes change-of-mind returns. Product-page badges may differ; confirm the applicable terms, dimensions and inclusions with the seller before payment.

profiles.buy_route: Yes: owner can source boards/hardware after approved shop drawings; obtain a fabrication quote.
profiles.execution: Direct-hire a cabinetmaker, or use the interior contractor. Review tall/heavy fixed units and unknown anchorage with the engineer.
profiles.reason: The quoted work is custom fitted fabrication, not a loose retail product.
profiles.checks: Measure depth, curves, doors, board grade, edge finish and fixings. Approve any ready-made substitution.
profiles.diy_scope: Selection and procurement only; hire the named trade for execution.

profiles.buy_route: Yes: select slab and finish after the fabricator measures and accepts the support.
profiles.execution: Use a stone fabricator for cutting, handling, joints and fixing. Engineer review for uncertain support or significant added load.
profiles.reason: Stone size, support and fixing determine both fit and safe handling.
profiles.checks: Approve slab thickness, substrate, adhesive, edges and carrying access.
profiles.diy_scope: Selection and procurement only; hire the named trade for execution.

profiles.buy_route: Buy only against the glazier’s measured specification and approved opening details.
profiles.execution: Engineer/design review of opening, safety glazing, tracks/hinges and supports; glazier installs.
profiles.reason: Large glass doors and sliding systems need coordinated supports and safe movement.
profiles.checks: Check glass type/thickness, hardware load rating, track, stops and escape route. Zero quoted quantity remains zero.
profiles.diy_scope: Selection and procurement only; hire the named trade for execution.

profiles.buy_route: Yes: owner can purchase from a brand dealer after capacity, electrical supply and installation scope are confirmed.
profiles.execution: Have the services engineer confirm load/location/supports; dealer installs and commissions with an electrician.
profiles.reason: Product supply does not complete refrigeration, drainage, wiring or outdoor support work.
profiles.checks: Clarify the quote’s “1.5 MT” wording, copper length, drain, isolator, outdoor bracket, testing and warranty.
profiles.diy_scope: Selection and procurement only; hire the named trade for execution.

profiles.buy_route: Yes: buy the electrician’s specified strip, driver, cable and accessories; do not select by price alone.
profiles.execution: Electrical planning/review, qualified installation and testing; direct booking still needs this handoff.
profiles.reason: These lines include fixed electrical work, not only a plug-in retail strip.
profiles.checks: Agree driver rating, voltage, heat dissipation, circuit protection, access and testing.
profiles.diy_scope: Selection and procurement only; hire the named trade for execution.

profiles.buy_route: Yes: choose fittings after wattage, driver and cut-out/support requirements are approved.
profiles.execution: Electrician installs and tests; engineer coordinates circuits and ceiling supports.
profiles.reason: Fixed ceiling/wardrobe lights connect to the building’s electrical installation.
profiles.checks: Confirm fitting counts, compatibility, access, earthing and support before ceiling closure.
profiles.diy_scope: Selection and procurement only; hire the named trade for execution.

profiles.buy_route: Yes: owner may select/buy after weight, support point and electrical specification are accepted.
profiles.execution: Engineer reviews support/anchorage; electrician and installer fit and test the suspended fixture.
profiles.reason: A hanging fixture combines a falling-object risk with electrical work.
profiles.checks: Confirm fixture weight and independent support, height, wiring and commissioning.
profiles.diy_scope: Selection and procurement only; hire the named trade for execution.

profiles.buy_route: Yes: buy a coordinated board/frame/fixing system after drawings and quantities are approved.
profiles.execution: Engineer/designer reviews suspension, anchors and service openings; ceiling contractor installs.
profiles.reason: A ceiling is an overhead system with concealed fixings and coordinated lights.
profiles.checks: Agree system details, board type, curvature, support, access panels and light supports.
profiles.diy_scope: Selection and procurement only; hire the named trade for execution.

profiles.buy_route: Yes: order the brand sign directly after size, material and illumination are defined.
profiles.execution: Sign maker fits. Add an electrician if lit; engineering review if heavy, high or external.
profiles.reason: The quotation does not specify the sign’s weight, support or electrical scope.
profiles.checks: Resolve those details first; a lightweight unlit indoor sign may then be owner-managed.
profiles.diy_scope: Selection and procurement only; hire the named trade for execution.

profiles.buy_route: Yes: source approved panels with the matching framing and fixings; request an installed quote.
profiles.execution: Engineer/designer reviews attachment and material suitability; specialist installs the frame and panels.
profiles.reason: The quoted scope includes framing, not a simple decorative surface sheet.
profiles.checks: Confirm frame layout, substrate, fixings, services and material fire performance.
profiles.diy_scope: Selection and procurement only; hire the named trade for execution.

profiles.buy_route: Yes: select a mirror only after measured glass, edge, backing and support details are agreed.
profiles.execution: Glazier/fitter installs. Engineer reviews large/heavy mirrors or uncertain substrate and fixing.
profiles.reason: Wall-mounted glass needs reliable support and handling; the studio mirror is a large measured area.
profiles.checks: Confirm safety backing, joints, wall condition, clips/adhesive and nearby wet/electrical services.
profiles.diy_scope: Selection and procurement only; hire the named trade for execution.

profiles.buy_route: Yes: purchase the approved framing, board and fixing system against a take-off.
profiles.execution: Engineer/designer reviews non-load-bearing layout, attachment, services and egress; contractor installs.
profiles.reason: A framed partition changes the internal layout and needs a complete connection detail.
profiles.checks: Check height, stud/frame specification, openings, moisture/fire needs and service routes.
profiles.diy_scope: Selection and procurement only; hire the named trade for execution.

profiles.buy_route: Owner may commission the complete item directly; an exact online match was not verified.
profiles.execution: Have the maker/glazier fabricate and assemble to the approved shape and stable base.
profiles.reason: The irregular glass shape and seating arrangement need a measured fabrication package.
profiles.checks: Confirm glass specification, finished edges, base support, seating clearance and delivery.
profiles.diy_scope: Selection and procurement only; hire the named trade for execution.

profiles.buy_route: Yes: owner can buy the sink/tap after the plumber and counter maker confirm sizes and connections.
profiles.execution: Plumber connects and checks leaks; seek services/engineering review for changed routes, penetrations or uncertain support.
profiles.reason: The item includes water and drainage connections, not only a sink purchase.
profiles.checks: Confirm cut-out, tap holes, trap, waste, isolation valves and a leak-test handover.
profiles.diy_scope: Selection and procurement only; hire the named trade for execution.

profiles.buy_route: Yes: compare ready-made racks on Daraz or a local furniture catalogue.
profiles.execution: Owner arranges delivery/assembly; use a fitter for any required anti-tip fixing.
profiles.reason: A suitable freestanding rack can be procured without a general interior package.
profiles.checks: Check capacity, width/depth, finish and stability. A fitted/custom replacement needs design approval.
profiles.diy_scope: Select, buy and assemble to the supplied instructions; get help for anchoring or heavy handling.

profiles.buy_route: Yes: owner can select a sample and order decorative rattan board through a finish supplier. Exact match not verified.
profiles.execution: Hire a finish carpenter directly for cutting/edging and surface fixing.
profiles.reason: Decorative surface finishing can be separately commissioned if no new frame or structural work is added.
profiles.checks: Confirm what “ratten board” means, backing, edge finish and fixation. Framing/heavy hanging work needs specialist review.
profiles.diy_scope: Selection and procurement only; hire the named trade for execution.

profiles.buy_route: Yes: choose the approved putty/primer/paint system and obtain supply or direct painting quotes.
profiles.execution: Hire a painter directly for preparation and application; competent owners may do small accessible touch-ups.
profiles.reason: Ordinary surface finishing can be managed independently of a main contractor.
profiles.checks: Assess dampness/cracks first; repairs, unsafe access or unknown coatings need the relevant specialist. Confirm coats and shade.
profiles.diy_scope: Colour selection, procurement and small accessible touch-ups; no structural repair, risky access or electrical alteration.

profiles.buy_route: Yes: source the specified putty/primer system and agree labour separately.
profiles.execution: Hire a finisher directly for preparation and smoothness; this quote says putty, not a separate full paint system.
profiles.reason: Surface preparation is a finish trade; the material and coats still need agreement.
profiles.checks: Confirm substrate soundness, dampness and whether primer/paint is excluded. Escalate repairs before finishing.
profiles.diy_scope: Selection and procurement only; hire the named trade for execution.

profiles.buy_route: Yes: buy or commission the completed sofa/couch directly from a furniture supplier.
profiles.execution: Supplier delivers and assembles; owner places it within the approved layout.
profiles.reason: A loose upholstered item can be ordered independently.
profiles.checks: Confirm actual unit/count, upholstery, dimensions, access, cleaning needs and warranty. Keep exits clear.
profiles.diy_scope: Selection and placement of a completed product; arrange help for carrying and assembly.

profiles.buy_route: Yes, for an approved finished freestanding granite table; supplier handling/assembly should be included.
profiles.execution: Supplier delivers/assembles. Custom stone cutting or fixed supports belong with a fabricator.
profiles.reason: A completed loose table can be owner-procured, with its weight and support confirmed.
profiles.checks: Approve the ready-made alternative, base stability, weight, access and any unusual floor loading.
profiles.diy_scope: Selection and procurement only; hire the named trade for execution.

profiles.buy_route: Yes: order matching decorative trim after the material/profile is approved. Exact quoted material is unspecified.
profiles.execution: Hire the finish installer directly for cutting and fixing to an existing sound surface.
profiles.reason: Simple finish trim can be separately commissioned.
profiles.checks: Confirm material, linear measurement, mitres and substrate; stone work, framing or service changes need a specialist.
profiles.diy_scope: Selection and procurement only; hire the named trade for execution.

profiles.buy_route: Yes: source an approved surface panel and matching finishing accessories.
profiles.execution: Hire a finish installer directly for surface fixing on a sound existing wall.
profiles.reason: This route is limited to non-framed decorative cladding.
profiles.checks: Confirm backing and fire suitability; if a new frame, overhead work or changed partition is required, move to the professional route.
profiles.diy_scope: Selection and procurement only; hire the named trade for execution.

profiles.buy_route: Yes: buy ready-made panels on Daraz or commission measured curtains from a Nepal furnishing supplier.
profiles.execution: Supplier/curtain fitter measures, stitches and fits tracks; owner can hang fabric on an already sound suitable rail.
profiles.reason: Fabric selection and direct fitting do not normally need a main construction contractor.
profiles.checks: Measure track length, finished drop, fullness, header, panel count and fixing surface. Quoted m² is not the number of retail panels. Heavy/high or uncertain supports need review.
profiles.diy_scope: Fabric selection and hanging on an existing sound rail; hire a fitter for new tracks, drilling, high access or heavy fabrics.

profiles.buy_route: Yes: select paint or lightweight wall art directly once the design scope is agreed. Exact fixtures are unspecified.
profiles.execution: Owner/painter can manage accessible surface decoration; hire a fitter for the approved lightweight fixtures.
profiles.reason: Simple decoration can be separated from the main construction package.
profiles.checks: This route excludes heavy, suspended, powered or structurally fixed art; use the appropriate specialist for those.
profiles.diy_scope: Selection and procurement only; hire the named trade for execution.

profiles.buy_route: Owner can compare supply-only and supply/install quotes after the actual floor area and grade are specified.
profiles.execution: Flooring specialist assesses the subfloor and installation; engineer review for structural, moisture or level changes.
profiles.reason: This is an unsplit allowance with no area, thickness, grade or material take-off.
profiles.checks: Measure first. A loose rug is not a substitute for the laminate scope; keep the allowance unallocated.
profiles.diy_scope: Selection and procurement only; hire the named trade for execution.

profiles.buy_route: Purchase only after an approved point/load schedule, material list and installation quote exist.
profiles.execution: Engineer plans/reviews the system; qualified contractor installs and tests.
profiles.reason: The lump-sum allowance has no circuit, point, cable or equipment breakdown.
profiles.checks: Keep the original allowance unallocated; obtain a detailed scope, test plan and contractor quote.
profiles.diy_scope: Selection and procurement only; hire the named trade for execution.

profiles.buy_route: Yes: purchase a finished loose rug/runner directly; ask a flooring supplier for fitted carpet.
profiles.execution: Owner can place a suitable loose rug; use a fitter for fitted carpet or edge treatments.
profiles.reason: Loose rugs are retail products; this is a new option outside the quoted laminate allowance.
profiles.checks: Measure its intended position; agree commercial-use suitability, secure non-slip backing, edges and trip/exit clearances.
profiles.diy_scope: Place a suitable loose rug with secure backing; fitted carpet and floor alterations need a flooring installer.

profiles.buy_route: Yes: owner can choose and buy a vanity package after dimensions, inclusions and connections are approved.
profiles.execution: Plumber connects/tests it; fitter verifies supports. Engineer reviews wall-hung anchorage or uncertain substrate; electrician handles any powered mirror.
profiles.reason: A purchasable cabinet still has plumbing and potentially heavy wall-mounted support requirements.
profiles.checks: Measure available width/depth, drain and water positions; confirm trap/tap, mounting hardware, waterproofing interface and installation cost.
profiles.diy_scope: Selection and procurement only; hire the named trade for execution.

options.title: Loose carpet or rug
options.scope_note: New owner-requested option. No separate carpet line exists in the quoted estimate; do not allocate the laminate allowance to it.

options.title: Bathroom vanity package
options.scope_note: Assumes a bathroom basin/cabinet vanity. A freestanding dressing-table vanity without plumbing follows the owner-managed furniture route. No bathroom vanity quantity is defined by the quoted decorative mirror or coffee-lounge sink; measure and agree the intended scope.
